title: Swap the order and the guard goes dead
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
10 match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case n if (n >= 3) -> "big"
  else -> "other"
}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
10 match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case n if (n >= 3) -> "big"
  else -> "other"
}

explanation.approach: Same two cases, reversed order. `10` satisfies both, but `match` stops at the first fit — `case n is Number` — so the guarded case below it never runs, for any number at all, not just this one.
